purpose: Explore genuinely different short-horizon mechanisms not already covered by discovery-v1, price-strategy-tournament-v1.1, evidence-backed-strategies-v2, Fibonacci, basis-convergence, cross-sectional momentum, gamma, or the existing ENA mean-reversion work.
research_order: execution economics and risk-path controls third
future independent forward evidence only after freeze

data.development_source: existing causal MEXC order-flow market_state observation ledgers

economics.notes: 12/16/20 bps are the repo's conservative current MEXC futures round-trip cases; no strategy is promoted from zero-cost results.

state_screen.primary_metric: median leave-one-capture-batch-out Spearman between continuous signal score and future signed return

simple_local_momentum.hypothesis: very short horizon local momentum can persist beyond the observation window

simple_local_reversal.hypothesis: very short horizon local moves can overreact and mean-revert

btc_lead_follow.hypothesis: BTC short-horizon movement can lead altcoin direction

btc_divergence_convergence.hypothesis: large short-horizon ENA/BTC divergence can converge toward BTC direction

book_pressure_follow.hypothesis: top-book imbalance predicts short-horizon directional pressure

microprice_pressure_follow.hypothesis: microprice displacement relative to mid predicts near-term direction

depth_flow_follow.hypothesis: depth change imbalance predicts short-horizon direction

pressure_consensus.hypothesis: aligned independent order-book and aggressive-flow pressure is more informative than any single pressure measure

queue_flow_consensus.hypothesis: static queue pressure plus dynamic depth flow plus microprice displacement identifies informed pressure

flow_price_disagreement_reversal.hypothesis: aggressive flow that is not reflected in price can indicate absorption and subsequent movement toward the latent pressure

absorption_fade.hypothesis: extreme aggressive flow with muted price response can indicate absorption and favor fading the aggressor

sweep_continuation.hypothesis: large price displacement with aligned aggressive flow and local range expansion can continue after a liquidity sweep

sweep_exhaustion_reversal.hypothesis: large price/flow impulse with microprice failing to confirm can mark sweep exhaustion and reversal

activity_flow_breakout.positive_activity_gate: rolling_trade_count_10s and local_range_to_spread_15s above training medians
activity_flow_breakout.hypothesis: flow imbalance is more actionable when activity and local range are elevated

liquidity_filtered_pressure.executable_liquidity_gate: spread_bps below training median and top_depth_notional above training median
liquidity_filtered_pressure.hypothesis: microstructure pressure should be traded only when spread/depth support realistic execution

strategy_translation.entry_thresholds: absolute continuous score above the predeclared training-only 70th or 85th percentile
